test_title: PYST 65: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.

Not a word __didn’t they speak__ to the others about the sad turn of events.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"did"** is used as an auxiliary verb in the past tense to form negative sentences or questions. (किया)

 
 
• **Example: Did** you complete your homework?
 
 
 
• **"Did they speak"** corrects the inversion needed for the sentence structure. (क्या उन्होंने बात की)
 
 
• **Example: **Not a word **did they speak **about the incident.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: No substitution** (कोई प्रतिस्थापन नहीं): This option implies that the given sentence is correct as it is, which is incorrect in this context.
 
• **Option 3: do they speak** (क्या वे बात करते हैं): This is incorrect because it uses the present tense "do" instead of the past tense "did".
 
• **Option 4: had they speak** (क्या उन्होंने बात की थी): This is incorrect because "had" should be followed by the past participle "spoken".

42:T1090,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
